preferredLength: Short to medium posts usually work best: enough context to establish relevance, but not enough to feel like a blog post.
tone: Credible, useful, and professional without sounding corporate or inflated.
structureTips: Open with a useful claim, result, or announcement
Add one or two sentences of proof or business context
trendSignals: Concrete outcomes and implementation lessons tend to outperform vague thought leadership
A little more context is usually tolerated if it earns the next line
